by
  intro 𝕜 _ H _ _ K _ x v
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨K.starProjection_apply_mem x, K.sub_starProjection_mem_orthogonal x⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact Submodule.eq_starProjection_of_mem_orthogonal h1 h2
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 H] (K : Submodule 𝕜 H) [CompleteSpace K] (x v : H), K.starProjection x = v ↔ v ∈ K ∧ x - v ∈ Kᗮ
